description: Target manifest for Western Disturbance Reliability Specialist, covering arrival timing, trough/center location, precipitation intensity, spatial displacement, duration, and rain/snow partition failure modes.

invariants.decomposed_evaluation: Arrival timing, trough location, precipitation amount, spatial displacement, duration, and rain/snow partition must be evaluated independently without collapsing into an opaque single score.
invariants.anti_leakage: All evaluation features strictly constrained to issue time t0. Verification against gridded rainfall, snow-depth observations, and IMD/NCMRWF synoptic charts sealed with 24h latency.
invariants.terrain_conditioned_validation: Validation must be partitioned across Western Himalayan High-Altitude (>2500m), Foothill/Sub-Himalayan (500-2500m), and Indo-Gangetic Plains (<500m) regimes.
invariants.rain_snow_null_safety: Rain/snow phase partition error must strictly be null unless high-altitude ground observations and freezing level/surface temperature are available.

targets.name: Western Disturbance Arrival Timing Error Exceedance
targets.description: Arrival timing error exceeding 6.0 hours at 24h/48h leads, or 12.0 hours at 72h+ leads.

targets.name: WD Trough and Center Position Placement Error Exceedance
targets.description: WD 500-hPa trough axis or surface induced center placement error exceeding 150 km at 48h or 250 km at 72h.

targets.name: WD 24h Precipitation Intensity Error Exceedance
targets.description: Forecast 24h accumulated precipitation intensity error exceeding 35.0 mm/24h in hill or plain sectors.

targets.name: WD Precipitation Centroid Spatial Displacement Exceedance
targets.description: Precipitation centroid spatial displacement error exceeding 100 km (misplaced orographic vs plains rainfall).

targets.name: WD Event Duration Error Exceedance
targets.description: Forecast event duration error exceeding 12.0 hours.

targets.name: WD Rain-Snow Phase Partition Failure
targets.description: Misclassification of precipitation phase (rain vs snow) evaluated conditionally when freezing level and surface temperature observations are present; strictly null when unsupported.
